_doc: Per-city local datasets for usa/local_flags.py. Green-only: every dataset here has an explicit licence that allows commercial use and redistribution (CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA / Public Domain / PDDL), checked in usa/research/licence_registry_local.json (2026-11-24); commercial_ok is 'yes' for all. Grey or red sources (disclaimer only, no stated terms, reserved rights) are not used and are named only in 'not_open'. Every reader in local_flags.py whitelists fields: names, phones, emails, agents, hosts, owners, grantors/grantees are never read. 'not_open' lists what was looked for and why it is not used. Sources: usa/research/state_local_realestate.json, rentals.json, hoa_occupancy.json (all checked 2026-11-24).
